commits.subject: money engine: a call a stop cuts off is booked but never read as an end; a spoken turn says no broken sentence (L3-run-5 review)

fixed.problem:
Blocking (review of 217902c, a sibling of L3-run-5): a spoken turn cut off by its timeout spoke a broken sentence.
- The loop's abort branch now books a cut-off call and emits model_call_end with stopReason "error".
- The chat agent's SentenceGate read every model_call_end as a normal end unless it stopped at max_tokens. So a voice or phone turn cut off by its 30 s timeout passed its held, unfinished sentence to the speaker ("The critic asked for one of the three options: adopt,"). Before the booking fix that tail was dropped.
- Stop all does not abort the protected chat run, so the timeout is how this happens.

Siblings found by checking every reader of model_call_end:
- The chat turn and the intake both took the first model_call_end as the time to first token.
- For a call cut off before any token, collectStream reports the time to the cut instead. So a timed-out chat turn recorded a first token at 30 s, and a timed-out planning call at 5 min (chat.reply ttftMs and the intake Run row's ttft_ms).
- The Performance page showed 'Text chat … 30.0 s / 30.0 s … 0% missed' where it used to show no first token.
- The executor and runner read only the cost, which is still booked.
fixed.failing_test_before:
All failed at 217902c and pass now:
- packages/runtime/test/voice-route.test.ts "l3-money-engine, run L3: a spoken turn its timeout cuts off > speaks the whole sentences that came before the cut and never the broken one": the TTS was asked to say ["You have a decision waiting.", "The critic asked for one of the three options: adopt,"].
- packages/runtime/test/conversation.test.ts "l3-money-engine, run L3: a chat call its timeout cuts off" (2 cases): onToken received the broken tail, and ttftMs was 30000 instead of null.
- packages/runtime/test/performance-route.test.ts "l3-money-engine, run L3: calls their timeout cuts off on the Performance view": text_chat ttftP50Ms was 30000. With only the chat fix in place, planning ttftP50Ms was 300000, so the intake half fails on its own as well.
fixed.how:
- agent/loop.ts exports a new constant, CUT_OFF_STOP_REASON = "aborted". "aborted" is already a StopReason value, and the normal path never emits it. The abort branch's model_call_end now carries it instead of "error".
- conversation/agent.ts and session/intake.ts skip an end with that stop reason. The gate's held rest stays unspoken and no first token is taken from it, exactly as before the booking fix.
- The cost readers (executor live Run cost, runner task and session booking) still count the event. The ledger, session, task, Costs and month figures stay equal.
- loop.test.ts's kill case now asserts the new stop reason (a test this area added, not weakened).
- Docs updated: runtime.md (kill mid-run, the chat gate), adding-a-provider.md, and the user guide ('A spoken answer only ever says whole sentences …').
fixed.check_in_the_app:
Bench (stand-in), run here:
1. Restart the daemon with --env FORERUNNER_BENCH_DELAY_MS=35000.
2. New project, open its Chat tab and type 'What is waiting on me?'.
3. Wait about 31 s. The reply reads 'I could not answer (run timeout).'
4. Open Performance. Before: Text chat '30.0 s / 30.0 s' first token, '0%', 'missed'. After: '— / —' first token, 'no sample', total '30.0 s / 30.0 s'.
5. Costs still rose by the cut-off call's input (7776 USD micro on the bench).

Live check 4 (real model):
1. Over the round, open Performance. Text chat's first-token p50/p90 should not show 30.0 s unless a reply really took that long, and Planning's first token should never be 5 min.
2. In Talk with Reply: Voice, an answer that stops early stops at a whole sentence and never says half a sentence. A real 30 s timeout cannot be provoked on demand with the real model; the voice-route test covers that path with a fake TTS.
3. Costs still lists the cost of every chat turn.

not_done.problem: Non-blocking review item: fire onStarted when the critic's checks start (marker checks, sandbox build and tests, tried pages), so the log is not quiet between 'The coder finished …' and 'The critic started …'.
not_done.why:
Not changed, on purpose.
- The budget or credential refusal happens at the critic's first model call, after the checks.
- So firing 'The critic started a light review' when the checks start would bring back L3-run-10's contradiction for a review with checks that a limit then refuses: 'The critic started …' followed by '"X" paused before its review: … no room for it'.
- A proper fix needs either a room check before the checks run, or a separate plain line for the checks ('The critic checks the work: running the tests.') that promises no review.
- Both are design choices for the critic / task-review area, not a cheap fix here.

Same reasons as in the fixer's report: a review-cost estimate and the Start dialog's start-check belong to other areas and to run C. The checklist line lives in the session lead's file, not the repository.

notes_for_other_areas:
agent/loop.ts (C3 d1109-chat-depth, anyone reading RunEvent): new export CUT_OFF_STOP_REASON = "aborted".
- The abort branch's model_call_end now carries stopReason CUT_OFF_STOP_REASON, not the "error" the fixer's notes named.
- The event means the call was booked but did not finish. A reader that books cost counts it (executor liveRunCost and ctx.onStep model, runner recordStep). A reader that treats it as the call's end must skip it: conversation/agent.ts (gate.end and ttft) and session/intake.ts (ttft) now do.
- Its ttftMs is the time to the cut when no token came.
- D3-12's 'the turn's cost equals its ledger rows' still holds through this branch.

conversation/agent.ts onEvent (not l3-chat-claims' history or reply-guard regions): the model_call_end branch is now `if (ev.type === "model_call_end" && ev.stopReason !== CUT_OFF_STOP_REASON) { gate?.end(...); ttft ??= ... }`.
